title: Tenders & Quotations
body:
## Government Polytechnic College, Kannur
### Official Tenders & Quotations Notice Board

Sealed competitive tenders/quotations are invited by the Principal, Government Polytechnic College, Kannur, for institutional procurement and services in accordance with Government of Kerala Stores Purchase rules.

---

### Current Open Tenders & Quotations

| Sl. No. | Tender / Quotation Reference | Description of Item / Work | Last Date & Time | Status |
|:---:|---|---|:---:|:---:|
| 1 | *No current open tenders* | *New tender notices and quotation schedules will be published here as and when invited.* | — | **Awaiting Notification** |

---

### General Terms & Instructions to Bidders
1. **Submission**: Quotations/tenders must be submitted in sealed covers superscribed with the tender reference number and addressed to the **Principal, Government Polytechnic College, Kannur, Thottada P.O., PIN - 670007**.
2. **Due Date**: Late or unsealed tenders will not be accepted under any circumstances.
3. **Rates**: Rates quoted should be inclusive of all taxes, duties, freight, and installation charges wherever applicable.
